Weibo.origin: Weibo user-post graph distributed with PyGOD/BOND (Liu et al., NeurIPS 2022 Datasets and Benchmarks); labels mark suspicious users from the original study (Zhao et al., 2020).
Weibo.edge_processing: symmetrised, coalesced, explicit self-loops removed; features unchanged (float32)
Weibo.redistribution: not redistributed; obtain from the source URL under its terms
Weibo.label_note: The distributed weibo.pt (sha256 above) holds 347 positives among 8,405 nodes (4.13%); the BOND paper table lists 868 (10.3%). We use the distributed file unchanged and report its prevalence.

Reddit-Real.origin: Reddit user-subreddit post graph distributed with PyGOD/BOND; labels mark users banned by the platform (Kumar et al., KDD 2019). Unrelated to the Reddit-Syn primary graph.
Reddit-Real.edge_processing: symmetrised, coalesced, explicit self-loops removed; features unchanged (float32)
Reddit-Real.redistribution: not redistributed; obtain from the source URL under its terms

Tolokers.origin: Toloka crowdsourcing worker graph (Platonov et al., ICLR 2023); edge = two workers on the same task; label = worker banned on a project.
Tolokers.edge_processing: symmetrised, coalesced, explicit self-loops removed; features unchanged (float32)
Tolokers.redistribution: not redistributed; obtain from the source URL under its terms

YelpChi.origin: Yelp hotel/restaurant reviews (Rayana and Akoglu, KDD 2015) as prepared by CARE-GNN (Dou et al., CIKM 2020); homogeneous union relation; label = filtered (spam) review.
YelpChi.edge_processing: symmetrised, coalesced, explicit self-loops removed; features unchanged (float32)
YelpChi.redistribution: not redistributed; obtain from the source URL under its terms

Amazon-Fraud.origin: Amazon musical-instrument users (McAuley and Leskovec, WWW 2013) as prepared by CARE-GNN; homogeneous union relation; label = fraudulent user. Nodes 0-3304 carry no label in CARE-GNN and are excluded from evaluation.
Amazon-Fraud.edge_processing: symmetrised, coalesced, explicit self-loops removed; features unchanged (float32)
Amazon-Fraud.redistribution: not redistributed; obtain from the source URL under its terms
